name: Delete Agent Session
description: Deletes a session on an agent, erasing the conversation: removes the session record (history, pending messages, metadata) and deletes the caller's associated job records that carry the conversation content. Use this to hold a private conversation and delete it afterwards. Any in-flight chat on the session is failed. Operators may disable this operation via venue config (adapters.agent.sessionDelete: false).

agentId.description: The agent that owns the session

sessionId.description: Hex ID of the session to delete

jobsDeleted.description: Number of back-referenced job records deleted along with the session
